slots.node01.text: Each level owns one class of decision. If a level has not acknowledged within its threshold, page the next level.
slots.node02.text: The clock runs from the first alert, not from the escalation.
slots.node03.body.item01.bullets.item01: Trigger: rollback invoked or go-live date at risk
slots.node03.body.item01.bullets.item02: Decides: reset the date; approve a new plan
slots.node03.label: L4 · Steering committee · 60+ min
slots.node04.body.item01.bullets.item01: Trigger: balances do not tie, or a gate is at risk
slots.node04.body.item01.bullets.item02: Decides: go or no-go; invoke full rollback
slots.node04.label: L3 · Controller and CIO · 30–60 min
slots.node05.body.item01.bullets.item01: Trigger: L1 cannot clear it, or the window slips
slots.node05.body.item01.bullets.item02: Decides: re-sequence steps; extend a window
slots.node05.label: L2 · Cutover lead · 15–30 min
slots.node06.body.item01.bullets.item01: Trigger: a step runs late or a check fails
slots.node06.body.item01.bullets.item02: Decides: retry the step or apply its rollback
slots.node06.label: L1 · Workstream lead · 0–15 min
slots.title: Four levels put every issue in front of a decision-maker
